# Workly India

Workly India is an Indian job platform connecting job seekers and employers. Job seekers can browse opportunities and apply through the website.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://worklyindia.devs.surf/)
- [Browse jobs](https://worklyindia.devs.surf/jobs)
- [Employer portal](https://worklyindia.devs.surf/employer-portal)
- [About Workly India](https://worklyindia.devs.surf/about-us)
- [How it works](https://worklyindia.devs.surf/how-it-works)
- [FAQ](https://worklyindia.devs.surf/faq)
- [Contact](https://worklyindia.devs.surf/contact-us)
- [Pricing](https://worklyindia.devs.surf/pricing)
- [Pricing data (JSON)](https://worklyindia.devs.surf/pricing.json)
